metadata.description: Dalt's Bazar — tekierz's collection of Claude Code plugins and skills: CLI delegation (Codex, Cursor), design languages, and more.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: cursor
plugins.description: Use Cursor Agent from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: cyber-deck-ui
plugins.description: Cyber-deck design language plugin — flat-phosphor instrument-panel UI (cyberpunk / retro-future / CRT / EVA) for whole applications: off-ghost materials, voice tokens, anti-bento composition, motivated motion, plus a style pack, demo app, local annotation tool, and convert/onboard/refine skills.

plugins.name: project-buildlog
plugins.description: Live build log page for any project, with a "Your tasks" panel: tick tasks, answer decisions and message the orchestrator from the page, and read its replies there. Local status server (systemd user service), task CLI, measured progress bars, HMAC-signed T3 Code webhook, hourly heartbeat and end-to-end checks.
